amendment_reason: The v1 offline bundle made no model calls and failed only because the largest StateMasked prompt was 70423 characters, 423 above the frozen 70000-character gate. V1.1 shortens only the value-mask spellings while preserving their type labels.

arm_definitions.B2-FullTrace-Control: Unchanged source FullTrace evidence, rerun contemporaneously.
arm_definitions.B2-TemporalShuffle: Within each episode, deterministically permute complete step records and reassign t to the displayed order; retain the exact multiset of non-t step content and exact serialized character count, while labeling the representation as lacking temporal order.
arm_definitions.B2-StateMasked: Preserve episode context, action/event sequence, reward, outcome, and field names; replace every step-state and predicate value with compact type-labelled tokens: <N>, <B>, <S>, <0>, <A>, or <O>.

interpretation_rules.temporal_contribution_supported: positive FullTrace-minus-TemporalShuffle mean and Holm-adjusted p below 0.05
interpretation_rules.state_contribution_supported: positive FullTrace-minus-StateMasked mean and Holm-adjusted p below 0.05
interpretation_rules.neither_supported: Do not claim a component-specific mechanism; retain only the already-confirmed FullTrace-versus-B1 representation effect.

claim_boundary: This new batch is a prospectively frozen mechanistic follow-up after the main B2-versus-B1 result was observed. It cannot retroactively become part of the original confirmatory primary analysis. V1.1 differs from the no-call v1 failure only in compact type-mask spellings.
